Improves my life!. Using this video alarm app adds quality to my life by helping me start my day on time, and on a much happier note than a typical alarm provides! I wake up to sounds I like, looped as long as I need to wake, which eliminates the need to use unkind tactics to startle myself awake each morning. Where startling awake leaves me anxious and unhappy, this video app wakes me up and practically does everything but bring me my coffee with a smile! Five stars. Take my money. 

Let’s talk function. The interface is easy, effective, and saves me time. I try so many new apps, Intuitive UI design is a sure fire way to keep my business. This app did not fall short. It’s almost supernaturally easy to use and love. This means when I’m rushing to bed, I’ll actually remember to use it, and will successfully set and reset my favorite alarms instead of defaulting to the built in alarm in my phone’s settings.

Adding life. Instead of having to choose from a short list of sounds like most apps, I have the whole massive YouTube library at my fingertips! Selecting a video that loops something pleasant and lasts for hours (like “space cats 10 hours!” prevents me from needing a “sleep function.” I wake sleepily singing along rather than wanting to throw my phone against a brick wall before I stomp on its splintered glittery remains!!! This adds years to my life and my phone. Word. 

The Anti-mad. It doesn’t tick me off with adds that make it hard to look at or use. It remembers my alarms for easy one-click resetting. It doesn’t NAG me to buy an upgrade or limit its utility so I’ll pay to find out what they can *really* do. 

This app gives it to me straight, which is awesome what it does it does well. It is useful, pleasant and makes me eager to throw some money at them in thanks for not being like everyone else. It starts me off with a smile each day into contented focus rather than startling me into productivity that makes me want to jump off a cliff! Well done.

Really good app. So out of all the music/alarm apps I’ve tried this is the first and only one I’ve found that does EXACTLY what I want. The ability to choose whatever song I want to wake up to is amazing. I don’t even mind the fact that my phone has to stay on all night, as it doesn’t seem to be effecting my battery life at all. 

There’s only two reasons I’m giving the app one star less than perfect, and those reasons are easily bypassed but still.

Reason 1 is that due to the fact that your phone is on all night, any notifications you get from the time you go to sleep to the time you wake up are not bundled up on your home screen. So usually I would wake up and scroll through the notifications on my home screen before I even open my phone. Because of this I’ve actually missed a few messages on my social media apps and didn’t realize it til much later. I’m really forgetful so it’s partially my fault for not checking them all afterwords, but still an observation. What I do now is I just swipe down and go into my notifications center once I’m awake. 

Reason 2 is a bit of a bigger issue, but still not that bad. So I’ve noticed that on one certain song that I keep trying to set alarms to, the app will set and act normal, but then in the morning the alarm won’t play and I sleep past it. It’s not just a certain video either but a certain SONG. I assume this is possibly because the song might be copyright? So I’ve tested multiple videos until I found one that seems to work. I know the app can’t bypass copyright if that is the issue, so the way I try to fix this is I just make sure to test the alarm before I set it. What happened on most of the videos I tried for this song would it would load for half a minute, then just give up. So just make sure to test your alarms first. 

Other then that, love this app!
